Compliant & Methodical

Our Structured 6-Step Resolution Path

A compliant, methodical escalation process designed to achieve rightful claim resolution through institutional frameworks.

1 Step 01

Submit Claim Details

Provide policy documents, insurer rejection/deduction letters, discharge summaries, and a brief description of the issue via our secure client portal.

2 Step 02

Initial Scrutiny

Comprehensive review of policy exclusions, conditions, and merits for a ₹500 non-refundable scrutiny fee to confirm legal validity.

3 Step 03

Case Assessment & Strategy

If viable, we formulate an advisory strategy; ₹4,500 advance credited against future success fee upon successful recovery.

4 Step 04

Insurer Grievance Escalation

Formal multi-tier representation drafted and submitted directly to the insurer’s Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) citing standard IRDAI guidelines.

5 Step 05

Insurance Ombudsman Filing

If the insurer rejects or delays response past 30 days, we compile and submit an official complaint before the regional Insurance Ombudsman.

6 Step 06

Resolution & Reconciliation

Claim recovery funds are disbursed directly by the insurer into your bank account, followed by fair reconciliation of our 15% success fee.

info

Important Regulatory Note: ClaimSathi focuses on formal insurer grievance redressal and Insurance Ombudsman representations. We do not provide automatic court litigation. Independent legal proceedings before Consumer Forums or High Courts require separate advocate engagement.

Answers & Clarifications

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear, direct answers regarding our scrutiny process, recovery approach, and fee structures.

No. ClaimSathi never guarantees recovery outcomes. Insurance decisions depend strictly on individual policy terms, factual disclosures, and IRDAI governing guidelines. Our role is to ensure your case is analyzed with high legal and factual scrutiny, presented effectively, and escalated through legitimate regulatory channels.
We charge an initial advance of ₹5,000 (comprising a ₹500 non-refundable scrutiny fee and ₹4,500 adjustable advance). If accepted and resolved, our 15% success fee applies only to additional money recovered, credited against your advance.
If your case is accepted after initial scrutiny but ultimately yields zero financial recovery, your ₹4,500 adjustable advance is refunded to your account within 30 working days. The ₹500 initial document audit and scrutiny fee is non-refundable.
Our process is centered on multi-tier insurer grievance escalation and representation before the Insurance Ombudsman. Court proceedings (such as Consumer Commissions or Civil Courts) require separate advocate engagement and are not automatically provided.
Yes. Our specialized NRI concierge desk routinely assists overseas policyholders and family members with cross-border communication, hospital paperwork collection, and coordinated grievance follow-ups in India.
